title: anti-base leak +
description: A simple texture pack that hides ores and a few other blocks to prevent your base from being leaked.
body:
A simple texture pack that hides ores and a few other blocks to prevent your base from being leaked.

blocks like : ores (stone and deep slate) granit, tuff, diorit, andisite, gravel, and the most important 'bedrock' respectivly replaced by eather stone or deepslate.
